description: Source code for zap logging levels and atomic level management, defining constants, types, and functions related to log levels and dynamic level control.

classes.name: AtomicLevel
classes.description: A dynamically changeable logging level that can be modified at runtime, implementing the LeveledEnabler interface.

methods.name: NewAtomicLevel
methods.description: Creates a new AtomicLevel with InfoLevel and above enabled.

methods.name: NewAtomicLevelAt
methods.description: Creates an AtomicLevel and sets it to a specified level.

methods.name: ParseAtomicLevel
methods.description: Parses a string to create an AtomicLevel with the corresponding level.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if a given level is enabled based on the AtomicLevel.

methods.name: Level
methods.description: Returns the current minimum enabled log level.

methods.name: SetLevel
methods.description: Sets the logging level of the AtomicLevel.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current level.

methods.name: UnmarshalText
methods.description: Unmarshals text into the AtomicLevel, setting its level accordingly.
